traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Helwingiaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins serrate; veins pinnate; blades lanceolate or ovate; stipules present; plants dioecious; ovary inferior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in umbels; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit drupe; parts of each whorl 3 to 4 (-5); stamens 3 to 4 (-5); carpels 3 to 4. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
